executionMode.reason: The transaction lock and the Write stream target a shared owned document; limit controls use the same owned namespace and must not overlap another campaign.

configuration.restoration: No configuration mutation is permitted. A configuration mismatch stops the campaign before owned data setup.

collectorBinding.technicalBlocker: The existing batch adapter is REST-only and the checked-in Write stream harness is a Rust local test. No production gRPC collector is bound; production execution is prohibited until an owner-approved collector contract exists.

comparatorBinding.contract: typed ordered status/error/body and post-state comparison; stream event sequence and transaction token binding must be added as a versioned contract before production admission
comparatorBinding.technicalBlocker: The current shared comparator does not compare bidirectional Write stream events or transaction token lifecycle; it cannot be used to claim a stream comparison.

cases.requirementSurface: FS-WRITE plus transaction lock ownership and atomic write refusal
cases.semantics: A write stream request that targets a document read by an active read-write transaction is refused with the production result classification, publishes no write from the request, and permits a fresh stream write after rollback. The uncontended control must succeed.
productionOperationSequence: GET owned guard and tail documents to establish absence
Commit one seed guard document in the owned namespace
Begin a read-write transaction
Read the guard document in that transaction and retain the transaction token
Open a bidirectional Write stream and complete the database handshake
Send one stream request containing an update to the locked guard and a second owned tail write
Fully receive the stream result and classify the refusal without assuming an error code
Read guard and tail to prove no mutation from the refused request
Rollback the transaction and verify completion
Open a fresh Write stream, handshake, and write the guard document
Read the guard to verify the post-rollback write
preflight: Read each owned document and require typed NOT_FOUND or the campaign stops
Read and bind database identity, edition, type, location and concurrency mode
Confirm the nonce is fresh and absent from all current campaign paths
Reserve one exclusive gate slot and the full recovery budget
setup: Create only guard with an owned marker using Commit
Read back name, fields and updateTime
Do not create tail before the contended request
observation: Read guard under transaction to establish lock ownership
Submit guard update plus contended-tail create in one stream request
Receive all stream events until terminal refusal
Open a fresh stream and write guard after rollback
postStateReadback: guard retains the setup marker after refusal
guard contains the after-rollback value after fresh stream success
transaction is no longer usable after rollback
all stream response events are consumed before classification
cleanup: Read guard and bind its updateTime
Conditionally delete guard with that exact updateTime
Read guard and require typed NOT_FOUND
Read contended-tail and require typed NOT_FOUND
Record any uncertain resource and do not issue an unconditional delete
cases.comparator: Versioned typed stream/transaction contract: ordered handshake, refusal, terminal status, write-result cardinality, post-state and cleanup outcome; no token or timestamp byte equality
localPreRunControl: cargo nextest run --locked -p fireemu-adapter-grpc --test streams --profile pr
cases.configurationRestorationRule: No configuration changes. If a preflight or postflight configuration digest changes, stop and leave the data journal for the named recovery owner.
cases.productionOnlyReason: The local gRPC test establishes fireemu behavior only. Production transaction lock ownership, Write stream refusal precedence, stream terminal framing and error classification require a live Firestore observation under the same Standard Native concurrency mode.

cases.semantics: A document at the accepted boundary is stored, while an immediately over-boundary document is refused atomically and leaves no partial document. Nested values are checked with the same post-state contract.
productionOperationSequence: GET the exact-boundary and over-boundary document names to establish absence
PATCH the exact-boundary document with a generated boundary payload
GET the exact-boundary document and verify typed fields
PATCH the over-boundary document with a minimally larger payload
Record the structured refusal and do not retry
GET the over-boundary document and require typed NOT_FOUND
PATCH a nested boundary control with valid individually sized fields
GET the nested control and verify its fields
PATCH a nested over-boundary document
GET the nested over-boundary document and require typed NOT_FOUND
preflight: Require all four generated names to be absent
Bind the document-limit contract revision and generated payload digest
Confirm that the request and response byte reservation covers the generated payload
setup: Generate boundary payloads from the pinned local limit constants
Use one request per document so refusal scope and post-state are distinguishable
postStateReadback: exact and nested-exact documents are present with typed payload digests
over and nested-over documents are absent
cleanup: Read each present document and bind updateTime
Conditionally delete only matching owned versions
Read every target and require typed NOT_FOUND
Retain any uncertain target for manual recovery
cases.comparator: Existing typed REST comparison contract with exact status/code, field presence/types, generated payload digest and absence readbacks

cases.configurationRestorationRule: No configuration changes. The generated payload and limit-contract digest are immutable campaign inputs.
cases.productionOnlyReason: The local limit tests do not establish the managed Firestore limit boundary or error classification for the configured Standard Native database. The exact boundary must be compared to a complete production receipt.

recovery.journal: private append-only ownership journal; record attempts before dispatch
recovery.deleteRule: Only delete a document after a typed readback, ownership marker check and exact updateTime conditional delete; otherwise record unrecovered and stop.
recovery.configurationRule: There is no configuration mutation. A preflight/postflight mismatch stops cleanup decisions that depend on the mismatched baseline.
recovery.processRule: The local shadow must stop all owned Firestore processes and release the shared gate before completion; production runner must prove transport quiescence before recovery.
recovery.uncertainResourceRule: Never enumerate or delete outside the nonce namespace; retain the journal for the named recovery owner.
